default.title: Shadow training, store shipping, and printer setup
default.summary: ClawPilot now adds order-level Shadow training, Shopify location routing, multi-account cart-rate callbacks, exact UPS and FedEx shipping-account proofs, and downloadable local printer pairing.
features: Deleted starter packaging assortments can be intentionally recreated with fresh material identities and audit evidence
Shopify fulfillment and tracking activation remain independently selectable when checkout-rate callbacks still need a registered CarrierService

One Shopify CarrierService can retain up to eight TEST and eight LIVE direct UPS/FedEx billing accounts; Shadow rates only TEST sources and Active rates only LIVE sources through a callback separate from event webhooks

Carrier setup keeps USPS and LTL modes visible without presenting them as checkout-ready; LTL readiness follows account classification policy, exact palletization, density-derived class, and then rating

Shipping Settings can rate an exact sandbox or production UPS/FedEx sender account, create and print the exact selected label, and void it; LIVE label purchase is isolated behind Active Operations, production-label authority, warehouse permission, explicit REAL POSTAGE confirmation, and trusted Railway runtime identity

Shadow orders from a connected Shopify or Faire sandbox or production store can enable an order-specific local training run that simulates plan, release, pick, pack, and completion while the provider order continues to mirror normally

Shopify location setup can read merchant and app-managed fulfillment locations, map an eligible merchant location to an existing warehouse, or atomically create a ClawPilot warehouse and inventory route from its verified address without writing to Shopify

An independently gated development-only location administration control can create, edit, or activate eligible merchant-managed Shopify locations after explicit review; app-managed fulfillment-service locations stay read-only
Sales Channels separates connected accounts, setup in progress, and an add-channel catalog so an unconfigured Shopify or Faire provider is not presented as already integrated
Printer settings distinguish a configured local printer from an agent that has actually connected
Mac pairing keeps each workspace credential and printer endpoint local while allowing one physical printer to serve separately enrolled workspaces
Operations > Printing can download a credential-free macOS raw-ZPL preview, issue a ten-minute pairing code, and show truthful connected, offline, or previously-seen agent state
fixes: A stale starter-assortment receipt no longer reports deleted packages as available
Multiple UPS or FedEx billing accounts no longer overwrite one another in Shopify checkout rating evidence, and identical public services resolve to one deterministic best account offer
Concurrent identical Shopify callbacks cannot attach another receipt's carrier evidence, and TEST/LIVE account drift is reported per account without silently deleting the opposite saved group

Shadow training can use factual warehouse, package, and product definitions without requiring real inventory, packaging stock, or a mappable Shopify fulfillment assignment, while database guards keep canonical warehouse and commerce records unchanged
UPS live-postage readiness returns a precise blocked response instead of an opaque server error, while TEST and LIVE selections continue to route only to their fixed sandbox and production APIs
Durable print jobs fail closed until the assigned local print agent records its first heartbeat
Local print acknowledgements use opaque device references instead of persisting or displaying raw printer hostnames and IP addresses
A lost print acknowledgement response no longer downgrades a locally delivered artifact or permits an automatic resend
